description: This file defines interfaces related to process container management in a C++ project, including iterators for network interfaces, memory info, processor info, and container entities, as well as a container administrator singleton for managing container instances.

classes.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Iterator interface for network interfaces within a container, providing methods to retrieve interface name and IP addresses.

classes.name: IMemoryInfo
classes.description: Interface representing memory usage statistics of a container, including allocated, resident, and shared memory.

classes.name: IProcessorInfo
classes.description: Interface providing CPU usage metrics for a container, including total usage and per-core usage.

classes.name: IContainer
classes.description: Interface representing a container instance with methods to retrieve its ID, PID, memory, CPU, network info, and to start or stop the container.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Factory method to create a new container instance with specified ID, search paths, log path, and configuration.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Enables logging for the container framework with specified log path and options.

methods.name: Containers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all container IDs.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a container by its ID.

calls: IContainer* Container(const string&, IStringIterator&, const string&, const string)

ctags.pattern: /^    class IContainerIterator : public Core::IIterator, public Core::IReferenceCounted {$/
